monthly_transactions.rationale: Representative monthly transaction throughput for an established national MFS provider in Bangladesh.

scam_attempt_rate.rationale: Estimated 0.8% of transaction volume targeted by phishing, impersonation, or account takeover attempts.

avg_loss_per_successful_scam_bdt.rationale: Average reported victim financial loss per successful mobile financial services fraud incident.

analyst_cost_per_hour_bdt.rationale: Fully burdened hourly cost of Level-1 / Level-2 fraud operations review personnel in Dhaka.

baseline_minutes_per_case.rationale: Average manual investigation time required to reconstruct transaction logs, SMS history, and agent checks without AI support.

takabondhu_minutes_per_case.rationale: Streamlined investigation time using automated 3-part case cards, rule traces, and mule network graph visualizers (75% time reduction).

analyst_daily_review_capacity.rationale: Target daily operational triage capacity for human fraud operations team.

attempt_success_rate.rationale: Conservative assumption that 35% of scam attempts would succeed in actual fund extraction if no safety friction was applied.

program_cost_annual_bdt.rationale: Estimated annual software licensing, cloud compute inference infrastructure, monitoring, and program maintenance expenses (~$154,000 USD/year).
